title: Snail waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M14 76 Q14 64 30 64 L66 64 Q82 64 82 74 Q82 82 68 82 L28 82 Q14 82 14 76 Z' fill='#7ED957'/>

  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='24' fill='#C46A2B'/>

  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#F0A66B' stroke-width='3'/>

  <path d='M52 50 m0 -16 a16 16 0 1 1 -0.1 0' fill='none' stroke='#8A3E12' stroke-width='3'/>

  <path d='M18 62 Q24 68 31 62' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A66' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M36 66 Q44 56 50 46' fill='none' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='43' r='6' fill='#8FE05A'/>
  <path d='M50 38 L49 33' stroke='#8FE05A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 37 L54 32' stroke='#8FE05A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
